provenance.query: select asset,symbol,step,jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array((b->>'time')::bigint,(b->>'open')::numeric,(b->>'high')::numeric,(b->>'low')::numeric,(b->>'close')::numeric) order by (b->>'time')::bigint) as candles from public.gbop_market_history cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(payload::jsonb) b where asset in ('NAS100','SPX','XAUUSD','XAGUSD') and step=60 and day_utc=extract(epoch from timestamptz '2026-10-02 00:00:00+00') and (b->>'time')::bigint>=extract(epoch from timestamptz '2026-10-02 11:00:00+00') and (b->>'time')::bigint<extract(epoch from timestamptz '2026-10-02 16:00:00+00') group by asset,symbol,step order by asset;
provenance.sanitization: Only market symbol, resolution and OHLC/time were selected; no account, member, journal, trade, quote, credential or personal data.
limits: Retained broker bars, not independent exchange verification or an owner's chart screenshot.
No tick order, member execution, entry fill, stop, realized R or profitability can be inferred.
Historical replay is not a live-session or Discord audio acceptance test.
